need to determine the crime(s). Facts: The defendant is legal representative of a company, and he evaded paying wages to 51 employees, total 378,912 RMB. Government ordered payment, still not paid. The court auctioned equipment to pay 115,206 RMB. He confessed.

The relevant offense: "拒不支付劳动报酬" (refusal to pay labor remuneration). Also possibly "单位行贿"? No bribery. Not fraud. So only one charge: 拒不支付劳动报酬.
